appName.message: Inkling – Chinese glosses for English words

appDesc.message: Chinese glosses, US IPA and audio for unfamiliar English words on CNN, BBC, YouTube & more, matched to your vocabulary level.

not_in_dict_word.message: This word isn't in the dictionary, so AI is explaining it in context.

not_in_dict_phrase.message: This phrase isn't in the dictionary, so AI is explaining it in context.

ext_updated.message: Inkling was updated. Reload the page and try again.

not_default_site.message: {0} isn't on the default list. Once you allow it, Inkling runs on this site only.

ai_plan_not_granted.message: Signed in to ChatGPT, but plan usage isn't authorized

ai_unconfigured.message: Not set up (add an API key or sign in with ChatGPT in Settings)

auto_title_off.message: Connect an AI model in Settings first

sites_desc.message: By default Inkling runs only on the English news and video sites below. To use it elsewhere, click "Enable on this site" in the toolbar popup.

level_desc.message: Words ranked within the top N by frequency count as known and are not glossed. Words in your learning list are always glossed; words in your known list never are.

near_desc.message: Words around this level (left ones count as known; outlined ones get glossed):

quiz_desc.message: 40-word quiz: 4 words from each of 10 frequency bands. Tick the ones you definitely know to estimate your vocabulary.

display_desc.message: A word is glossed only the first time it appears in a paragraph. Click a glossed word to open its card; select any word or phrase to get the "注" button.

color_note.message: On dark pages, a color that would be hard to read (such as black) automatically switches to light gray.

ipa_desc.message: US IPA comes from CMUdict (e.g. tariff /ˈtɛrəf/). The word card always shows it; this switch only affects glosses on the page. Not shown in "Underline only" mode.

auto_speak.message: Pronounce automatically when a card opens

voice_note.message: Uses the browser's built-in speech synthesis; available voices depend on your OS.

voice_count.message: Uses the browser's built-in speech synthesis. {0} English voices are available on this device.

voice_none.message: No English voices found, so pronunciation may not work. Add an English (US) voice in your system settings.

lists_desc.message: One word (base form) per line. Click Save and open pages update immediately.

ai_desc.message: Powers "Explain in context" on word cards and the optional AI-optimized glosses. Pick either way to connect.

api_key_note.message: Stored only on this device (chrome.storage.local). Never synced or sent anywhere except the base URL above.

chatgpt_head.message: Use your ChatGPT account (counts toward your Plus / Pro plan)

chatgpt_desc.message: After signing in, AI explanations count toward your ChatGPT plan, no API key needed. Sign-in happens on OpenAI's page; Inkling never sees your password.

need_api_access.message: Allow access to {0} to use this base URL

got_models.message: Found {0} models. Pick one in the Model field.

auto_desc.message: As you read, the model re-decides what each paragraph needs glossed for your level.

auto_li1.message: Glosses fit the context, not just the first dictionary sense;

auto_li2.message: Drops what you don't need: names, places, and words you probably know or can guess;

auto_li3.message: Adds what a frequency list misses: uncommon senses (brace in "markets brace for…" means 准备应对) and phrasal verbs/idioms (rule out, in the wake of);

auto_li4.message: Word cards show the in-context meaning and CEFR level (A1–C2).

auto_warn.message: Uses noticeably more quota: one model request per paragraph you read (short neighbors are batched). Off by default. Results are cached, so a paragraph isn't re-requested at the same level. Dictionary glosses work as usual when this is off.

about_text.message: The offline dictionary is built from {0} (MIT license); US IPA comes from CMUdict; Japanese and Korean gloss packs come from Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0). Pronunciation uses the browser's built-in speech synthesis.

gloss_lang_desc.message: Which language explains English words in glosses and word cards. Chinese is built in; the Japanese and Korean packs download from GitHub Pages the first time you choose them (about 0.5–1 MB) and then work offline.

pack_deleted.message: Deleted. Gloss language switched back to Chinese.
